summary: Frontend-only retest of the Hinglish voice-selection bug fix (composite voiceKey `${id}::${name}`) on ProjectDetail. Logged in as admin, created two fresh projects (TEST_Hinglish_Voice language=hinglish, TEST_English_Voice language=english) via /dashboard/new and exercised the voice picker. ALL 5 requested scenarios PASS. (1) Hinglish project: card order = Rohan, Anaya, Sanya, Aditya, Ishita, Vikram (all hinglish) then hindi then english; auto-selected card = Rohan (hinglish, volt-yellow + SELECTED); NO lang-mismatch-warning in DOM. (2) Clicking voice-card-Rohan and then voice-card-Sanya moved SELECTED correctly and the warning stayed hidden (0 nodes) — the old duplicate-voice_id bug (Rohan resolving to Liam/english) is gone. (3) Clicking voice-card-Aria on the Hinglish project rendered lang-mismatch-warning with exact text 'Script is hinglish but selected voice is english. Consider a matching voice for natural delivery.' — language reflects the actual selected voice. (4) Hover preview: hovering voice-card-Aria fired exactly 1 POST /api/ai/tts/preview (HTTP 200) and audio played; re-hovering the same card fired 0 additional network calls (client cache keyed `${voiceId}::${projectLanguage}` works). (5) English project: auto-selected Aria (english), no warning; selecting Rohan produced 'Script is english but selected voice is hinglish'. No console errors during the voice flows (only benign 401 on the pre-login /auth/me probe and 404s on empty asset lookups).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx previewCache/hover key is `${voiceId}::${language}` (id only, no name). Functionally correct today because duplicate catalog entries map to the SAME ElevenLabs voice, but if a duplicate ever gets different settings (stability/style) the cached clip would be wrong. Consider keying by the composite voiceKey.

The real root cause is data: /api/catalog/voices (ai_services.INDIAN_VOICES) exposes the same voice_id under multiple display names. The composite key masks it in the UI; consider making catalog entries carry a unique slug/key from the backend so every consumer (VoiceStudio, project.voice_id persistence) is safe. Note project.voice_id stored in Mongo is still id-only, so on reload the auto-pick re-derives the name via voices.find(v => v.id === project.voice_id) — which can again resolve to the WRONG display name/language (e.g. saved Rohan reloads as Liam). Recommend persisting voice_name alongside voice_id.
ProjectDetail.jsx is 951 lines — above the 700-line guideline; splitting the voice picker / storyboard / render panels into components would help.

rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed fixed. Previously voices.find(v => v.id === voiceId) returned the first catalog entry sharing that ElevenLabs voice_id (Liam/english instead of Rohan/hinglish), so the mismatch banner and voice metadata were wrong. State is now the composite `${id}::${name}` and lookup matches on (id, name); DOM verification shows correct SELECTED card and correct/absent warning in all tested combinations.
